evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: A conceptual distinction asserted as self-evident, framing the argument's logical foundation without appealing to authority or position.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Supplies a factual reframe — commodity vs. asset — that controls the interpretive frame while arguing from the logic of the distinction.
